serverInfo.description: Search and trace US federal rules across the Federal Register (proposed/final rules, notices, and presidential documents), the eCFR (codified, point-in-time CFR full text and amendment history, locally mirrored), and Regulations.gov (rulemaking dockets, document files, and public comments) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
